reviews.author: Mara Minor
reviews.text: Absolutely great mechanic! It was a Sunday with a time time sensitive load & they got me rolling asap. Needed a new hub assembly. They picked up the only part I could find 1.5 hours away, installed asap, communicated, & the prices were exactly as quoted. Rates were very fair. Emailed my receipt and we were rolling. I wouldn't call anyone else.

reviews.author: Fleet Dept
reviews.text: Good service, We called them for wheel seal replacement on our truck and they did a great job. The mechanic was professional and their dispatch miss Maria kept us updated throughout the repair. Even when unexpected issues came up he handled everything properly and made sure the job was done right. Fast response, fair service and quality work. Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Darren McDougle
reviews.text: Maria arrived to the inspection site and fixed my problem quickly and I was able to get a recheck before the officer left. I recommend her to anyone. Plus she’s very cute.

reviews.author: Iroc 86
reviews.text: I broke down on 85 South bound near Geer SC. Called Maria. And with no hesitation she was quickly out to me and got me going and off the highway. I called and 15min later she was there. Would definitely recommend this shop to anyone. Thanks Again for all you help

reviews.author: Jamal Griggs
reviews.text: This is your place and the staff is very experienced. Maria is the best and very patient, resolved my issue before a technician could even reach my destination. Thanks Maria!

reviews.author: Best Shoh
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience at this shop and felt compelled to share my appreciation. From the moment I walked in, I was treated with genuine respect and professionalism. The staff were not only friendly but also incredibly attentive, making sure all my needs were met with care and efficiency.

reviews.author: Ismir Kapic (Floris Logistics Inc)
reviews.text: Great company, very helpful, even though they didn’t have a mechanic available at the time for computer diagnostics, they pointed me in the right direction. It made it way easier for us.

reviews.author: Sean Wilson
reviews.text: Very prompt and punctual!! Went above and beyond to service my trailer with a service line that had been snapped off and very fair pricing!! She was EXCELLENT!! I'd HIGHLY recommend if you're in thd Upstate Area!!

reviews.author: Nicole Rey Jackson
reviews.text: Responded at 12am. Very professional and willing to negotiate! I recommend this company above all. Thank you so much for your help! Best wishes!

reviews.author: Germinie Turner
reviews.text: Great Company, I blew a radiator and I thought it was a hose. Maria diagnosed what she thought it was and her tech Russ confirmed it. Both where very professional and courteous. Russ replaced my radiator and all this was done before myv10 Hr reset. I called several places and they still haven't returned my call 2 days later. I highly recommend this Company. Russ is a great technician. Thank you Maria for getting me back on the road. Fellow truck drivers Maria may be a woman but she know het stuff.

reviews.author: Miguel Osorio
reviews.text: 24/7 Semi Truck Road Service & Towing .Service exelente Russ is professional with the knowledge of the Equipment dispatch great thank you very much fast and professional

reviews.author: Nathan Sweigart
reviews.text: All around Great Experience; service was quick, people were nice, and surprisingly enough, they worked pretty clean. Definitely Recommend if you need quick, Straightforward, services.

reviews.author: Parizod INC
reviews.text: The quality of service truly stood out, everything was handled with great attention to detail, and it’s clear that they take pride in what they do. It’s rare to find a place that combines such high standards with a warm and welcoming atmosphere

reviews.author: Gerrant Osborne
reviews.text: Very very great service and even better response time! Gave them a call to come out and fix 3 air lines on my dump truck and express how argent I needed it done told me it would be a hour wait and that actually showed up 30mins before!! Highly recommended

reviews.author: George Uwakwe
reviews.text: Maria is 5-STAR REVIEW OUTSTANDING SERVICE from Maria at Diesel Fleet Service! **Rating: 5/5 Stars** Maria saved my business (Lex Terra Transportum, Inc.) from downtime by: * Quickly diagnosing my truck's issue * Efficiently repairing it with precision and care * Getting me back on the road FAST! Her expertise, professionalism, and friendly service exceeded expectations! **HIGHLY RECOMMEND Maria and Diesel Fleet Service!** George Uwakwe"

reviews.author: Ronald hall
reviews.text: I broke down in the mountains of South Carolina, carrying 12,000 lbs on my trailer. Being unfamiliar with the area (I live in MO) and it being a weekend, I was hopeless! I Googled roadside truck repair and Diesel Fleet Services was the ONLY service shop willing to help. Russ came out, on a Saturday mind you, and after examination, found a massive hole in my resivoire. Without the part on hand, he brainstormed temporary fixes that could get me home. His price was fair and the work reliable as I was able to make it home to my regular mechanic. My mechanic described the temp fix as "genius." Thanks, Russ, for an honest job done well!

reviews.author: Lloyd Gonzalez
reviews.text: Great people! since the very first time I called them. The lady on the phone was very nice. Russ was awesome and did everything that I expected to do. I'd recommend with no doubt. That's the kind of people we need for the trucking industry.

reviews.author: Darren Bromell
reviews.text: Great roadside service , they make it their business to get someone out to you as quickly as possible , very efficient!!!

reviews.author: The Real One
reviews.text: 24/7 trucking services were very helpful and professional on getting my truck serviced! deffiently will use them more often

reviews.author: Zachary Ness
reviews.text: Maria was really nice on the phone, had an airbag pop on my trailer and was blocking entrance into a facility was able to bypass it and get unloaded. Had Russ the mechanic sent out to me to get that fixed and had him replace 3 belts on my reefer unit and he did a great job and very respectful. Would definitely recommend if you’re in a pinch or need work done on a semi/trailer.

reviews.author: Lance Rotting
reviews.text: Maria, is on point! Crossing through South Carolina when my service truck completely shredded a tire. Not being from the area I checked google and the reviews for quick quality repairs. Maria with Diesel Fleet Services took my call and worked her magic to get me back on the road. Within 45 min she had a tech onsite on the side of interstate 85 working on my truck. Service tech did a good job in a timely manner. Maria followed up upon completion and I was back on the road. Honestly could not have gone smoother.

reviews.author: Valenz
reviews.text: Really easy to talk to. I needed a computer diagnostic, and the guy they sent (Igor) was really helpful and was there in 30 minutes. Makes me happy there’s still good people out there not trying to rip people off.

reviews.author: William Wynn
reviews.text: I am extremely impressed with their service! The technician was prompt and very professional. I would also like to add that they’re not overpriced like other tire shops. Great service and great prices.

reviews.author: Ruben koboji
reviews.text: Maria was very helpful. I stayed for 16 hours for a trailer airbag to be changed. In the end, they told me they didn't have the airbag. I called Maria, and she dispatched the mechanic, and they got it done and fair price.

reviews.author: Jesus Parra
reviews.text: Had an airbag fixed here. Service was fast, even on a Friday night! Work was solid and price was fair. No runaround, just got it done. Boss even came by to check in on me. Sending all our trucks their way from now on.

reviews.author: Bill Goins
reviews.text: Coming into North Carolina, I blew a radiator hose on my Freightliner Coronado. I called Diesel Fleet service and spoke with Maria. Her service tech Russ was already on a call but she went and picked up my part and had it ready for him when he got back. They had me back on the road in under 3 hours. I could not have been more thrilled! I highly recommend them and will definitely be calling if I ever have another issue in that area. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Matt Rhyne
reviews.text: I can't put into words how great it feels to have a mechanic that treats your vehicle like it's his own baby!! My 2014 Infiniti aka my baby had some issues recently but we are back up and running as good as ever thanks to Nick Trust me he will come to you fix you up for a fair price absolutely Stress free!! Thanks again Nick I'd give 100 stars if I could!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Tara Green
reviews.text: Called for a jump and was originally told they catered more to tractor trailers. But Maria text me right back and offered to come jump my car! She was very thoughtful and kind! Will definitely keep this company in my back pocket!

reviews.author: Ernie Marte
reviews.text: Best thing that came from an out of service d.o.t inspection was finding this company. Maria was great and russ came in about 20-30 mins. They both knew my exact issue and he finished in an hour. 5stars will definitely call again

reviews.author: Sean Ross
reviews.text: So my JLG, SkyTrak 1054, went down on a commercial roofing job mid-morning on a Saturday. Boom Extended. No one answered, but these guys. Came out in less than an hour, and in 15 min, we were up and running. Thank you Thank you Thank you.

reviews.author: Michelle Love
reviews.text: It was after hours and they were able to get my driver up and running in no time. Fast and professional. Very welcome change from most service calls I have to make. Thank you very much!

reviews.author: Michael Petrucelli
reviews.text: Maria was excellent when we brought our box truck down to the shop. Russ got our roof fixed promptly and they took care of our def light problem. We won't be calling another mechanic.

reviews.author: Jessie Sohi
reviews.text: Definitely recommend them my truck had air leak and everyone was closed but these guys and they came within 30 minutes and fixed it. Super genuine prices and they work with you instead of ripping you off like other mechanics.

reviews.author: Virginija Narkunaite
reviews.text: Tech came out late at night for a road service call. He was very fast and got me back on the road quickly. Maria the dispatcher was really kind and helpful! Would recommend all truckers!

reviews.author: Jason Faasse
reviews.text: I called for service at 3am on Sunday morning. Maria was there in 30 minutes! She had me on the road immediately! I will use this company in the future! I highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: EWT
reviews.text: Broke down in Greer, SC and was blessed to have found such an honest and thoughtful company to get me going again. They went above and beyond the scope of practice to ensure i wasn’t out of service for the entire weekend, especially considering i was hauling sensitive freight. They made so many sacrifices on my behalf, even when the odds were against me. If it weren’t for a prior road FAILED service call of a competitor, i would have never found these great people. They truly do bring back the lost skill of customer service. Not only do they do everything in their power to make sure you’re taken care, but they also make sure that your your satisfaction is achieved! Thank you Diesel Fleet Service for helping me through a terrible experience. Highly recommend this company for any of your service needs.

reviews.author: Russell Derosia
reviews.text: Great guy Russ is. Maria is fair in price per tire and very knowledgeable. Would recommend anytime. 10 out of 10

These people are great to do business with and would recommend to any other Dumptruck drivers I work with .

Professional and smooth transaction.

reviews.author: the driver
reviews.text: These folks are awesome!!! I was having trouble finding a specific tire size and they were able to find two tires for me. They are very professional!!! I will definitely be calling them again. Thanks to Max and his Boss Lady I was up and running.

reviews.author: Nek Smith
reviews.text: Maks.. is an outstanding mechanic, not only did he respond within the hour.. he had us on our way within 45 minutes.. he was personable. polite and professional as well as their Dispatcher Maria. Even though they are 2 hours from our place of business, we plan on utilizing Diesel Fleet Services in the near future. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Danny W
reviews.text: WARNING: STAY AWAY!!!!! They charged us $1,000 for a single tire change. BUT The "mechanic" mounted the tire on a damaged rim, causing it to fall off when we got back on the road! When we informed them they came back after few hours later, then they finally inspected the rim and wanted to charge us an additional $600. We explained we couldn’t afford that, but they still took another $300 from us for no valid reason and without fixing the rim or anything, they charged us because of the "mechanic" got back. When we asked for assistance on the price, they threatened to call the state patrol! We had to get help from another tire shop and got it fixed with less than $200!!

reviews.text: Stranded with my Sami truck on the side of the road with huge air leak when this nice girl Maria come from nowhere and stop to help me. Not just that help me also she went to pick up my part from Volvo Dealer. Because of her I was able to continue my load in no matter of time. That’s what I say customer service. Well done Maria.
